needs.what: Station symbols (721) on triggered and static/keyword abilities: a `threshold: {counter: charge, at_least: N}` that makes the permanent HAVE a triggered ability (3+ 'whenever you cast an artifact spell' trigger), a keyword (12+ Flying) and a static self-buff (12+ '+1/+0 for each artifact you control') only at N+ charge counters, plus the Spacecraft rule that the permanent is an artifact creature with its printed P/T (0/8) only at its highest station threshold (12+) and a noncreature artifact below it
needs.why_existing_wont_do: Ability.threshold is accepted only on activated abilities (the packet notes: 'Activated abilities only'); a trigger `condition` or static `condition` on counters would leave the ability on the permanent, which the notes forbid for striations; and nothing gates the Spacecraft becoming a 0/8 artifact creature at 12+ -- a counters-conditioned set_types static would approximate rule 721 rather than implement station. The Station activation itself is expressible (tap_permanents with `as` + add_counters power_of), but the card is only partly expressible
